{{Top|leg}}
A '''Drop-fighter''' was a type of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] capable of [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. During the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]] Drop-fighters bombarded [[Duro/Legends|Duro's]] planetside industrial factories. The bombardment caused the environment to be exposed to toxic chemicals, which allowed [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] to easily claim victory.
